dialog: 4/16 - I've always been cursing God.
The entrance ceremony, sports day, the school trip. I have almost no memories of them.
They're all chipped away, incomplete.
Why keep me alive if you won't give me an ordinary youth?
Why me? Why did I get sick? Why do I have to die? Why, why, why?
Drop dead, God.
9/4 - My story hasn't even begun yet. Does it end here?
I want to spill it all. I don't want to die. I'm scared. I want to scream.
I want to tell them. I want to reach out. "Help me." Hey, why is it only me?
But I don't want to be a curse on them.
I saw a news story about the annual suicide statistics and things like that.
Life isn't fair at all. Nothing at all is equal.
Hey, please, someone.
I promise I won't waste it. I'll do anything.
I'm begging you. Give that life to me.
10/9 - My story. A life with me at the center.
But even if I'm gone, the world will keep turning. Everyone's stories will go on.
millsage. Will it end? Will it go on?
Ah, but I hate it. The thought of someone other than me at the center.
It makes me sick.
millsage. My happiness.
At least millsage... Burn it along with my coffin.
Kanata-san. I finally understand—what it is I truly have to do
I was wrong from the very beginning. Everything I've done, all of it.
I'm sorry. Kanata-san.
I didn't understand your true wish at all.
I just took those words at face value, got it into my head all on my own, and turned the band into a mess.
And then, I stole the center spot of millsage.
I am truly sorry.
No amount of apologizing will ever be enough. I can never atone.
So at least, to make amends for what I've done to you...
I'll throw away my own "happiness."
I love happy endings.
I love stories where, in the end, everyone is smiling.
But this story isn't mine.
There's no way I should make it my story.
There's no way I should be the protagonist, or even a character in it.
—And so. The one standing here isn't "me."
Just a tool to make sound.
Singing just to grant wishes—just a piece of stage machinery.
Rainbow colors. That homework from Kanata-san. I never needed any of that from the very start.
Someone like me, wishing for her own happiness... I was nothing but a fool.
I'll guide Mahoro-san and the others to Comet.
And I'll bring an end to millsage.
That way, Mahoro-san's and everyone's wishes, and Kanata san's wish... they can all be granted equally, right?
Hey, Kanata-san. This time, I'll make it happen for sure.
My throat and my fingers. My voice and my keyboard.
Bringing only those with me to this place...
I'll shine. Only for everyone's happiness.
And then, there you'll see. What a wonderful happy ending :D
